title: Firmware
macRequiresWindows: Firmware upgrades require the PonyABC Desktop app on Windows. This feature is not available on Mac.

prepare.title: Prepare your pen
prepare.checklistUsb: Connect the P5 pen to this computer with a USB cable.
prepare.checklistPower: Keep the pen connected and powered for the whole upgrade — do not unplug it.
prepare.checklistNoOtherOps: Make sure no other file operation (BOOK, DIY, or another upgrade) is running.

package.title: Firmware package
package.devModeNotice: Test/support only: pick an already-extracted vendor package folder yourself. Most people should use the official download above instead.
package.looksValid: This folder has the files the confirmed upgrade path needs.
package.invalid: This folder is missing files the upgrade needs. Nothing will be run.

official.loading: Checking for the official firmware release…
official.noRelease: No official firmware release has been published yet.
official.noNetwork: Could not reach the update server. Check your internet connection and try again.
official.downloadFailed: The download failed. Check your internet connection and try again.
official.verifyFailed: The downloaded file failed verification and was discarded. Please try again.
official.extractFailed: The downloaded package could not be extracted. Please try again or contact support.
official.onPenVersionHint: This app cannot read the firmware version already on the pen — there is no reliable way to query it today.
official.hardwareRevNotice: This firmware applies to hardware version {{hardwareRev}}. This app cannot automatically detect the connected pen's hardware version.
official.hardwareConfirmLegend: Confirm the connected pen's hardware version:
official.hardwareConfirmYes: Confirmed — my pen is hardware version {{hardwareRev}}
official.hardwareConfirmRequired: Confirm the hardware version above before continuing. If you're not sure, do not proceed — check the pen or contact support.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.summary: Ready to upgrade using the package at {{path}}.
confirm.uacNotice: Windows will ask you to approve this — please respond to that prompt yourself when it appears.
confirm.alreadyInProgress: A firmware upgrade is already in progress.
confirm.unsupportedPlatform: Firmware upgrades are only available on Windows.

upgrading.title: Upgrading
upgrading.phaseAwaitingAuth: Waiting for Windows authorization, or starting…
upgrading.phaseToolRunning: Writing to the pen — do not disconnect it…
upgrading.noCancelNotice: The upgrade cannot be force-cancelled once it has started.

result.title: Result
result.failedTitle: The upgrade did not start or did not complete.
result.unclearTitle: The result could not be confirmed.
result.unclearBody: The tool finished without showing the expected success message. The pen may or may not have been upgraded successfully — check it manually before using it, or try again.
result.unclearBodyUnconfirmed: We could not confirm whether the upgrade tool has actually finished running. For safety, no new firmware upgrade or BOOK/DIY pen write is allowed while this is unresolved. Please fully quit and reopen this app only after you have independently confirmed (for example in Windows Task Manager, or by checking the pen itself) that the process has stopped.
result.acknowledgeButtonUnconfirmed: I understand — I will restart the app
result.restartNoticeAcknowledged: Noted. This app will stay locked against new firmware upgrades and BOOK/DIY pen writes until you fully quit and reopen it.

recovery.title: Previous upgrade not confirmed finished
recovery.stillRunningBody: A firmware upgrade from a previous session appears to still be running outside this app. Restarting this app is not evidence it has stopped. New firmware upgrades and BOOK/DIY pen writes stay blocked, and this app will not attempt to stop the other process itself.
recovery.unknownBody: This app could not determine whether a firmware upgrade from a previous session has finished. New firmware upgrades and BOOK/DIY pen writes stay blocked until this can be confirmed.
